collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A navigator wonders whether distant sailors might read the stars the same way Isolans do.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a navigator, wonders whether distant sailors might read the stars the same way Isolans do.

choices.label: Teach a Child to Read the Stars.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The navigator imagines sailors far away following the same bright points across the sea.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A scholar wonders whether different seas might show different stars.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A builder imagines distant sailors using clever objects shaped like discs or spoons to find their way.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An elder wonders whether such objects might make sailors forget how to read the sky.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The child learns three new stars and is very proud.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Clouds roll in, and the lesson becomes a story about stars instead.
